summary: Seattle-based; merged with Hawaiian Airlines, and both share one baggage policy and the Atmos Rewards program.
checkin: Online and app check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Bag drop and airport check-in close 40 minutes before domestic flights.
baggage: Carry-on and personal item are free on every fare. In North America the 1st checked bag is $45 and the 2nd $55 (up to 50 lb, 62 linear in; tickets from April 10, 2026). First Class gets 2 free bags up to 70 lb.
tips: Atmos Rewards Visa cardholders and Atmos status members get free checked bags.
Club 49 members (Alaska residents) check 2 bags free.
Bag fees can be paid during online check-in, at a bag tag kiosk or at the counter.
